explanation_en: Based on the five-observation average, the yield curve is flattening. This score measures signal intensity; it is not a certain recession probability.

drivers.detail_en: Daily volatility is smoothed with the five most recent valid observations.
The spread is positive but below 0.50 and should be monitored.
Freshness describes data quality, not forecasting certainty.

backtest.note_en: This descriptive backtest uses one indicator and currently revised data. Its results do not guarantee future performance.
